plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing split files (train_split.json, val_split.json), and any pre-trained models. Check what labels directories exist (labels_yolov8x_1280, labels_sc, etc.). Understand what has already been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace contents, understanding of existing configs and splits

plan.title: Deep dive: data, splits, products, existing models, and environment
plan.hypothesis: Understanding all available resources at once will let us skip unnecessary setup steps
plan.description: Combined exploration: (1) Load annotations.json - count per-category annotations, image dimensions, avg annotations per image. (2) Check train_split.json/val_split.json sizes and split ratio. (3) Explore data/products/ directory - count reference images per product, cross-reference with categories. (4) Search ENTIRE workspace recursively for .pt weight files (trained models). (5) Check GPU availability, CUDA version, installed packages (ultralytics, torch, timm, pycocotools versions). (6) Read all YAML config files fully. (7) Check data/metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Complete picture of all available resources, especially whether pre-trained models exist

plan.title: Build evaluation pipeline and verify/create 90/10 split
plan.hypothesis: A reliable evaluation function is essential before any experiments
plan.description: Write utils.py with: (1) COCO evaluation function computing detection_mAP@0.5 (all cats mapped to one class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original categories), returning val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Use pycocotools COCOeval. (2) Verify existing train/val split or create 90/10 stratified split with seed=42. (3) Helper functions for YOLO-to-COCO prediction conversion. (4) Install any missing packages in requirements.txt.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function works on dummy predictions and returns sensible scores

plan.title: Baseline: evaluate any existing trained models or train YOLOv8x at 1280
plan.hypothesis: If pre-trained models exist, we can get a baseline immediately; otherwise YOLOv8x at 1280 with nc=357 should achieve val_score > 0.20
plan.description: If .pt files from previous training were found in step 2, load and evaluate them on val split. Otherwise, train YOLOv8x with nc=357 at imgsz=1280 for 150 epochs using existing data_multiclass.yaml. Evaluate on val split with our evaluation function. Record detection_mAP, classification_mAP, and val_score.

plan.title: Train nc=1 single-class detector at 1280
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes, and detection is weighted 70%
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 at imgsz=1280 for 150 epochs using data_single_class.yaml. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. Compare against nc=357 model's detection performance.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improves over nc=357 model

plan.title: DINOv2 embedding gallery + kNN classification pipeline
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images and training crops can classify detected crops better than YOLO's built-in classification for 357 categories
plan.description: Build DINOv2-base embedding gallery from: (1) reference product images in data/products/, (2) training annotation crops. For each category, store mean embedding. Implement kNN classification (k=5, cosine distance) on detected crops from val images. Test standalone classification accuracy on GT boxes first, then combine with nc=1 detector.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP with DINOv2 exceeds YOLO nc=357 classification mAP

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining best detector (nc=1) with DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections, crop each detection from full-res image, embed with DINOv2-base, classify via kNN against gallery. Compute full val_score = 0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP. Compare against nc=357 YOLO end-to-end.

plan.title: NMS tuning + max_det optimization
plan.hypothesis: With ~91 annotations per image on average, default NMS settings may be suboptimal for dense shelves
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold (0.4-0.8), confidence threshold (0.05-0.3), and max_det (100-500) on val split using best detector. Record detection_mAP and val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Find settings that improve detection_mAP by at least 1 point

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for small product detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images catches small products missed by single-pass inference
plan.description: Implement SAHI-style sliced inference: split each image into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride ~960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Test on val split. Measure detection_mAP improvement and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improves by 2+ points over single-pass inference

plan.title: DINOv2 kNN hyperparameter tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning k, temperature, gallery composition improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Sweep k (1,3,5,7,11), temperature (0.01,0.05,0.1), gallery variants (reference only, crops only, both, weighted). Measure classification_mAP for each on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Find configuration that improves classification_mAP by 2+ points

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO classification when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain yields better results than either alone
plan.description: For detections from nc=357 YOLO, if class confidence > threshold use YOLO's class, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep confidence threshold. Also try: always DINOv2, always YOLO, gated approach.
plan.success_criteria: Gated approach outperforms both individual methods

plan.title: TTA and multi-scale inference
plan.hypothesis: Test-time augmentation improves detection by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on val split. Also try running same model at multiple scales (640, 1280, 1920) and fusing with WBF. Compare detection_mAP and measure inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Improvement in detection_mAP while staying within 300s inference budget

plan.title: Assemble best pipeline and optimize for submission
plan.hypothesis: Combining all best techniques achieves the highest val_score
plan.description: Assemble the full pipeline with best detector, best tiling config, best classification method, best NMS settings. Run end-to-end on val split. Measure total inference time and model sizes.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score achieved, within time and size constraints

plan.title: Build submission run.py and package
plan.description: Write run.py implementing the best pipeline. Ensure only allowed imports (pathlib not os, json not yaml). Test with simulated sandbox constraints. Verify weights < 420MB, inference < 300s. Package into submission.zip.
plan.success_criteria: Submission passes all constraint checks and reproduces val_score

plan.title: End-to-end submission verification
plan.hypothesis: The submission pipeline runs correctly within all constraints
plan.description: Run complete pipeline end-to-end on val images, timing each component. Verify output format matches COCO predictions. Verify total time < 300s, weights < 420MB. Run 3 times for consistency.
plan.success_criteria: Consistent val_score across runs, all constraints met
